channel.title: Brazil Elections 2026
channel.description: Real-time monitoring of the 2026 Brazilian presidential elections.

item.title: Veja a íntegra da nota de repúdio do Paraguai sobre fala de Lula
item.description: The Paraguayan government formally repudiated President Lula's recent remarks about the War of the Triple Alliance, stating that his claim that 'Paraguay decided to invade Brazil' distorts historical facts and overlooks the conflict's complexity. Delivered to Brazil's ambassador in Asunción, the note urges a historically responsible and reconciliatory approach, acknowledging the deep and lasting scars the war left on Paraguay.

item.title: Jaques deve manter versão de que foi até Mendonça por demanda de prefeito
item.description: Allies of Senator Jaques Wagner (PT-BA) say he will maintain that he requested a meeting with Supreme Court Minister André Mendonça at the behest of a Bahia interior mayor, days before PF's Operation Compliance Zero, to discuss political-administrative matters related to the state. The meeting took place in Mendonça's office on the same day the PF filed requests for data access and wiretapping, which the minister cited as evidence of potential leaked confidential information.

item.title: Podemos adia decisão sobre aliança com Flávio Bolsonaro
item.description: Podemos postponed its decision on a possible alliance with Flávio Bolsonaro, delegating the choice to its national executive by August 5. The party opted not to run its own presidential candidate and leans toward neutrality, despite PL’s efforts to secure Centrão support. Bolsonaro has not yet announced his running mate, keeping the vice-presidential slot open for negotiations, with Daniella Marques of Republicanos as his preferred pick.

item.title: Crusoé: Janaina Paschoal se rebela contra cacique do PP
item.description: São Paulo city councilwoman Janaina Paschoal, from the PP, criticized her party's decision to exclude Senator Tereza Cristina from Flávio Bolsonaro's (PL) presidential ticket. She argued that the PP must focus on removing the PT from power and that Tereza Cristina is a suitable figure for that goal. The statement highlights an internal rift within the PP over its 2026 electoral strategy.

item.title: Recusa do PP para Tereza Cristina ser vice abala corrida à presidência do Senado e frustra Marinho
item.description: The PP vetoed the possibility of Tereza Cristina becoming vice president on Flávio Bolsonaro's ticket, which disrupted the efforts of Senator Rogério Marinho, who supported the alliance. This decision strengthens Tereza Cristina's bid for Senate presidency in 2027, as she removes herself from the vice-presidential race and maintains her focus on leading the Senate. The PL aims to nominate Marinho for Senate president, but faces internal resistance, as Tereza Cristina enjoys broad support even within the party.

item.title: Atlas/Bloomberg: maioria culpa família Bolsonaro por tarifaço de Trump
item.description: An Atlas/Bloomberg poll shows 45.4% of Brazilians hold the Bolsonaro family primarily responsible for the 25% U.S. tariffs on Brazilian goods, compared to 41.5% blaming the Lula government. A plurality (43.3%) believes the tariffs are politically motivated to influence Brazil's 2026 presidential election, narrowly outweighing economic explanations (39.6%). Despite the trade dispute, 45.6% expect the Lula administration to successfully negotiate a reduction in tariffs.

item.title: Brasileiros veem tarifaço injusto e com viés político, mas dividem culpa entre Lula e Flávio
item.description: The Atlas/Bloomberg poll shows 59.4% of Brazilians view the new 25% U.S. tariff on Brazilian imports as unjustified, while 43.3% believe its main goal is to influence Brazil’s 2026 presidential election. On blame attribution, 45.4% hold the Bolsonaro family responsible for allegedly lobbying the U.S. to pressure Brazilian courts, and 41.5% blame the Lula government, claiming its anti-American actions triggered the trade retaliation.

item.title: Lula veta projeto que transformava o Cefet-MG em universidade federal
item.description: President Luiz Inácio Lula da Silva vetoed the bill that sought to transform Cefet-MG and Cefet-RJ into federal universities, citing unconstitutionality due to lack of executive initiative, as reorganizing federal public administration falls under the president’s exclusive legislative power. The bill, approved by the Senate, would have created UTFMG and UTFRJ with administrative, financial, and pedagogical autonomy, preserving technical courses while expanding into undergraduate, graduate, teacher training, research, and extension programs. The veto will now be reviewed by Congress, which may uphold or overturn it with an absolute majority in each house.

item.title: Engenheiro ambiental Felipe Schroeder dos Anjos alerta: cidades brasileiras seguem despreparadas diante de enchentes e deslizamentos
item.description: Brazilian cities remain highly vulnerable to floods and landslides due to outdated urban infrastructure and disordered occupation of risk areas, according to environmental engineer Felipe Schroeder dos Anjos. Although technical solutions are known — such as the 'sponge city' concept with green roofs and permeable drainage — there is a lack of continuous investment and technical capacity in municipal governments to implement them at scale.

item.title: Tereza Cristina confirma a aliados que aceitou compor chapa como vice de Flávio Bolsonaro
item.description: Senator Tereza Cristina told allies she accepted the invitation to be the vice-presidential candidate on Flávio Bolsonaro’s 2026 presidential ticket. However, the ticket’s formation still requires approval from the União Progressista Federation (PP and União Brasil) and formal endorsement from the PP at its party convention.

item.title: Cascas de banana e ‘cortina de fumaça’: os bastidores do choque de Milei para Flávio e Lula
item.description: Javier Milei's participation in the convention launching Flávio Bolsonaro's presidential bid was seen as a strategy to mobilize the bolsonarist base and divert attention from uncomfortable topics, though unlikely to expand his electorate. The Lula government initially sought to avoid escalation with Milei, viewing him as a 'scene game' for internal Argentine projection, while considering Donald Trump the more relevant external adversary. The controversy ultimately benefited Flávio by overshadowing pressures on his candidacy and reinforcing his alignment with Jair Bolsonaro's political identity.

item.title: Defesa de Silveira contesta violação de cautelar em vídeo com Portinho
item.description: The defense of Daniel Silveira argued before the STF that his appearance in a video published by Senator Carlos Portinho does not violate the precautionary measure banning social media use, as he did not request, authorize, edit, or disseminate the content, characterizing the statement as a spontaneous and protocol-driven social interaction. They urge Minister Alexandre de Moraes to recognize no breach occurred or, alternatively, grant a hearing for Silveira to provide personal clarifications.

item.title: Flávio reúne Tarcísio, Ricardo Nunes e vereadores em agenda de campanha
item.description: Flávio Bolsonaro, the PL party's presidential candidate, met in São Paulo with right-wing and center-right political leaders at a breakfast organized by Mayor Ricardo Nunes. The gathering included Governor Tarcísio de Freitas, Senator Rogério Marinho, and several city council members, as part of his campaign agenda.

item.title: Nunes Marques mantém no ar post crítico a Flávio Bolsonaro e aos Estados Unidos
item.description: TSE President Nunes Marques upheld a social media post by PT pre-candidate Thiago dos Reis, which claims Senator Flávio Bolsonaro seeks to turn Brazil into a U.S. colony through an invasion of supremacists. Although he acknowledged the post's strong language and derogatory associations, Marques ruled it falls within the bounds of political criticism and does not constitute demonstrable falsehood or honor violation sufficient for immediate removal. The decision will be reviewed by the TSE plenary, following a preliminary analysis limited to a request for video removal.

item.title: Sem chance de apoio explícito, Haddad faz agendas reservadas com prefeitos no interior para tentar minar Tarcísio
item.description: Fernando Haddad (PT) has held private meetings with mayors from Governor Tarcísio de Freitas' base in São Paulo's interior to undermine support for the governor, particularly in smaller cities, without seeking explicit endorsements but gathering criticism and intelligence for his campaign. The meetings took place in cities such as Avaré, Catanduva, and São José do Rio Preto, focusing on complaints about the lack of a regional development plan and the privatization of Sabesp.

item.title: Após reunião com embaixador brasileiro, governo do Paraguai diz que não quer aprofundar crise em período eleitoral
item.description: The Paraguayan government stated it does not wish to deepen the diplomatic crisis with Brazil following President Luiz Inácio Lula da Silva's remarks about the War of the Triple Alliance, accepting the Brazilian ambassador's explanations as sufficient to resolve the matter. Although a formal note of repudiation approved by Paraguay's Congress was delivered, officials emphasized they do not intend to interfere in Brazil's 2026 elections.

item.title: Michelle decide hoje com Valdemar futuro eleitoral no DF
item.description: Michelle Bolsonaro is expected to decide today, in a meeting with PL national president Valdemar Costa Neto, whether to run for Senate in the Federal District. The meeting, scheduled for this Friday in Brasília, could confirm her candidacy in the 2026 elections.

item.title: Bolsonaro segue com “instabilidade do equilíbrio” e “sonolência diurna”, diz médico
item.description: Former President Jair Bolsonaro is experiencing bodily imbalance and daytime drowsiness as side effects of medications, according to a weekly medical report submitted by his defense to Minister Alexandre de Moraes of the STF as side effects of medications, according to a weekly medical report submitted by his legal team to Minister Alexandre de Moraes of the STF. The document, signed by cardiologist Brasil Ramos Caiado, was filed on Friday and reported by O Antagonista.

item.title: Com impasse na federação, União Brasil faz convenção no Rio sem confirmar Canella para o Senado e apoio a Douglas Ruas
item.description: The União Brasil convention in Rio de Janeiro did not confirm Márcio Canella’s Senate candidacy nor support for Douglas Ruas as governor, leaving the federation with PP in deadlock. The party stated the decision will be made on the 4th, with neutrality in the state race remaining a strong option. The PL is attempting to preserve the alliance by backing Canella’s candidacy despite his investigations for money laundering and illegal firearm possession, to secure electoral airtime.

item.title: Lula diz que Alvorada é ‘desumano’ para morar: ‘café chega frio, cerveja chega quente’; veja vídeo
item.description: President Luiz Inácio Lula da Silva criticized the Palácio da Alvorada as an unsuitable official residence, stating its sprawling layout makes daily life inhumane, citing examples such as coffee arriving cold and beer warm due to the long distance from the kitchen. He noted the building, with eight rooms, was designed for large families but is mostly occupied by older presidents without young children, making it uncomfortable to live in despite its photogenic appeal.

item.title: Secretário diz que governadores rejeitam União, mas pedem ajuda dos EUA
item.description: National Public Security Secretary Chico Lucas stated that there is a contradiction in governors who reject federal intervention in public security but simultaneously request external support from the U.S. to combat organized crime, which he views as incompatible. He defended the Public Security PEC as necessary to clarify responsibilities between the Union and states, emphasizing that rising organized crime demands coordination among federal entities. Lucas also praised the Lula administration as the most invested in public security in Brazil’s history, citing the creation of the National Force, the federal penitentiary system, and strengthening of the Federal Police and Federal Highway Police.

item.title: O impacto que o novo capítulo do caso Lulinha pode ter na eleição, segundo cientista político
item.description: The new investigation into Fábio Luís Lula da Silva, son of President Lula, may provide ammunition for opponents in the 2026 campaign, but its impact on voting intentions will be limited, according to political scientist Rubens Figueiredo. This is due to the solidification of public opinion about Lula after years of scandals and a kind of 'voter anesthesia,' where the electorate has already formed a fixed image of the petista, making significant shifts in perception unlikely.

item.title: 'Respeito, mas não desisto nunca', diz Flávio após PP vetar Tereza Cristina como vice
item.description: Flávio Bolsonaro said he respects the Progressistas' decision to veto Tereza Cristina as his running mate, but declared he 'never gives up' and will continue negotiating with other parties to form the best possible ticket. He noted the PP has opted for federal election neutrality and remains optimistic about alliances with other Centrão parties like União Brasil and Republicanos. The PL must finalize its ticket by August 5, risking an internal solution — such as Daniella Marques — if no agreement is reached with Republicanos.

item.title: Jaques Wagner diz que vai 'provar inocência' após Mendonça retirar sigilo de investigação que apura suspeitas no caso Master
item.description: Senator Jaques Wagner (PT-BA) said he is calm and confident he can prove his innocence in Operation Compliance Zero, which investigates alleged fraud, corruption, and money laundering linked to Banco Master. He stated he is focused on his Senate re-election campaign after Supreme Court Minister André Mendonça lifted the secrecy of the decision authorizing the operation’s 9th phase, allowing Federal Police to access his and a businessman’s phones. Wagner’s defense denies the allegations, claiming he never acted in favor of the bank and that the luxury apartment mentioned was never part of his assets.

item.title: PF identificou 74 ligações entre Jaques Wagner e Augusto Lima
item.description: The Federal Police identified 74 calls between Senator Jaques Wagner (PT-BA) and businessman Augusto Lima, former partner of Banco Master, from November 2023 to May 2025, totaling over 5 hours and 30 minutes of communication. The report, declassified by Supreme Court Minister André Mendonça, suggests Wagner received benefits such as private flights, concert tickets, and a luxury apartment in exchange for favoring Banco Master in Congress. Wagner stated he is calm, confident in proving his innocence, and focused on the October elections, with his party’s convention scheduled for Saturday and Lula’s attendance.

item.title: No primeiro mês de Desenrola, endividamento e inadimplência continuaram iguais
item.description: In the first month of the Desenrola Brasil program, launched in May, household debt and delinquency indicators remained largely unchanged, staying at record levels. The share of income committed to debt payments (excluding real estate financing) was 31.1% in May, down slightly from 31.2% in April, while delinquency rose from 7.4% to 7.6%, reaching its highest level since 2012.

item.title: Negociação de imóvel para Wagner seguiu após prisão de Vorcaro, diz PF
item.description: The Federal Police states that negotiations for the purchase of a luxury apartment for Senator Jaques Wagner (PT-BA) continued after the arrest of Banco Master’s former owner, Daniel Vorcaro, in November 2025, through 'contractual maneuvers' to conceal the illicit deal. The senator says he is calm and focused on the October elections, asserting he will prove his innocence and highlighting his support for Lula. Investigations are examining whether Wagner received improper benefits in exchange for legislative actions favoring Banco Master, within the Compliance Zero operation.

item.title: 'Pai do Lulinha’ e ‘onde está filho do presidente?': campanha de Flávio prepara ofensiva após nova investigação da PF
item.description: Flávio Bolsonaro's (PL) campaign plans to use the new investigation into Fábio Luís Lula da Silva, known as Lulinha, to attack President Lula in the 2026 election by calling him 'the father of Lulinha' and asking 'where is the son'. The strategy includes raising the issue in speeches at PL conventions in Santa Catarina, Tarcísio de Freitas' event in São Paulo, and in Paraíba and the Federal District, focusing on social media and public agendas to consistently wear down the opponent.

item.title: Paraguai entrega nota de repúdio a embaixador brasileiro
item.description: Paraguay delivered a diplomatic note of protest to Brazil's ambassador after President Lula claimed Paraguay 'invaded' Brazil during the Paraguayan War (1864-1870). Paraguay views the statement as an affront to its national memory, while Brazil signaled it will not respond, aiming to avoid historical debate and maintain bilateral relations.

item.title: Líder nas pesquisas ao Senado em SP, Marina Silva prega união com Simone Tebet e mira gestão Tarcísio
item.description: Marina Silva leads Senate race polls in São Paulo with 31% in Paraná Pesquisas and advocates for a ticket with Simone Tebet to boost women's political representation. She criticizes São Paulo's sluggish economic growth under Tarcísio de Freitas (1% in 2025 vs. 2.3% nationally) and highlights a 10% rise in femicide in the state during the first half of 2026, calling for urgent public safety measures.

item.title: Lula lidera no 1º e no 2º turno, mostra pesquisa, que traz disputa mais apertada contra Caiado
item.description: Lula leads voting intentions in the first round and would defeat all tested opponents in a potential second round, according to the Alfa Intelligence poll released this Friday. The tightest race is against Goiás Governor Ronaldo Caiado, who emerges as his main challenger. The survey was commissioned by TMC and published on March 31.

item.title: Lula diz que não tem a ‘quantidade de craques que queria’ ao citar sucessor
item.description: President Luiz Inácio Lula da Silva admitted difficulty in naming a successor for 2026, stating no current candidate can defeat the far-right, which led him to pursue a fourth term. He cited Dilma Rousseff (2010) and Fernando Haddad (2018) as examples of PT-developed successors and suggested new names may emerge from the 2026 state elections. Lula said he would have preferred to rest but feels compelled to run to block the far-right’s return, emphasizing his strong physical condition at 80 to counter age-related criticisms.

item.title: La policía de Brasil investigará a un hijo de Lula por presunta corrupción y tráfico de influencias
item.description: Brazil's Federal Police will launch an investigation into Fábio Luís da Silva, known as Lulinha, one of President Luiz Inácio Lula da Silva's five sons, on suspicions of corruption and influence peddling. The probe was authorized by the Supreme Federal Court following evidence that he may have leveraged his family name to facilitate business deals for friends in Brasília.

item.title: Cúpula do PP avalia que Tereza Cristina aceitou convite de Flávio porque sabia que partido barraria chapa
item.description: The leadership of the Progressistas (PP) believes that Senator Tereza Cristina accepted the invitation to be Flávio Bolsonaro’s running mate solely to appease agribusiness pressures in Mato Grosso do Sul, knowing the party would oppose the ticket. The PP argues that the PL 'missed the timing' for the alliance by failing to convene a national convention within the legal deadline, and that supporting the Bolsonaro candidate is no longer advantageous in the current political landscape, which favors Lula.

item.title: Lula reúne equipe econômica antes de viagem para convenções do PT
item.description: President Lula met with his economic team on July 31, 2026, at the Palácio da Alvorada to discuss fiscal and spending agenda ahead of PT conventions in Ceará and Bahia. Attendees included Finance Minister Dario Durigan, Planning Minister Bruno Moretti, Management and Innovation Minister Esther Dweck, and Secom Secretary Sidônio Palmeira. Foreign Minister Mauro Vieira was present but left before the meeting began for another engagement with the president.

item.title: Flávio e a jornada de um candidato sem alianças
item.description: The PP declared neutrality and blocked Tereza Cristina from being Flávio Bolsonaro's running mate, despite Bolsonaro claiming she had accepted the offer. Bolsonaro stated he continues talks with other parties, such as Republicans, to form his ticket. Lulinha's defense is studying a request to move a new investigation against him to a lower court, while Eduardo Bolsonaro cried when mentioning prison and threatened Kim with 'desire to beat him up' in the U.S.

item.title: Governo destina R$ 3,4 bi para subsídio de combustíveis
item.description: The federal government allocated R$ 3.473 billion in extraordinary credit to subsidize fuels, with R$ 2.230 billion for road diesel and R$ 1.243 billion for other petroleum derivatives. The measure was published in the Official Gazette on July 31, 2026, via MP nº 1.381, and signed by President Lula and Minister Bruno Moretti. Resources are managed by the Ministry of Mines and Energy, based on prior 2026 MPs.

item.title: Força eleitoral de Lula ainda é insuficiente para criar ‘onda vermelha’ nos estados
item.description: Lula leads presidential polls in eight of Brazil’s nine largest electoral colleges, confirming his favoritism for re-election in 2026. However, governors backed by him are leading in only one state (RJ, with Eduardo Paes) and trailing or tied in SP, PR, MG, and CE, revealing a split between presidential and gubernatorial voting. The PT aims to strengthen the link between regional candidates and Lula to create a 'red wave' and transfer presidential strength to state races.

item.title: Depois de polêmica em 2022, ACM Neto se declara branco à Justiça Eleitoral
item.description: ACM Neto, former mayor of Salvador and União Brasil candidate for governor of Bahia in 2026, declared himself white in electoral court records, reversing his 2022 self-identification as pardo, which had sparked controversy. He also doubled his declared assets from R$41.7 million to R$48.8 million. Despite the backlash, a Quaest poll shows him technically tied with incumbent governor Jerônimo Rodrigues (PT), with 39% versus 38% voting intentions.

item.title: Como vai funcionar o ‘Pix Pensão’, que torna o pagamento do pai automático
item.description: Law 15.479/26, signed by President Lula, establishes the 'Pix Child Support' system, enabling automatic and recurring payments via Pix to combat delinquency and reduce judicial overload. The law is in effect now, but its rules will apply starting July 2027, after a one-year adaptation period. While automatic deductions from formal salaries already existed, the new rule extends the mechanism to informal and self-employed workers, facilitating compliance with child support obligations.

item.title: Saiba quando começa a propaganda eleitoral e conheça as novas regras para as Eleições 2026
item.description: Electoral propaganda for the 2026 General Elections begins on August 16, as per TSE resolution, which strengthens measures against disinformation and regulates the use of artificial intelligence. The campaign includes online activities, free electoral airtime on radio and TV, and requires electronic addresses to be reported to the Electoral Justice, with updates within 24 hours if created during the campaign period.

item.title: Bastidores: PF tentou evitar distribuição automática para André Mendonça de nova investigação sobre Lulinha
item.description: The Federal Police attempted to prevent the automatic distribution of an investigation into Fábio Luis Lula da Silva, known as Lulinha, to Supreme Court Minister André Mendonça, sparking a behind-the-scenes conflict between the PF, the PGR, and the Court’s presidency. Tensions between investigators and Mendonça’s office escalated over nearly a week, culminating in an electronic reversal in the case assignment process.

item.title: União Brasil adia decisão sobre candidatura de ex-deputado investigado pela PF para o Senado no RJ
item.description: União Brasil postponed its decision on the Senate candidacy of Márcio Canella, former Rio de Janeiro state deputy under investigation by the Federal Police for suspected money laundering involving gas stations, for the 2026 election. Canella is part of the alliance supporting Senator Flávio Bolsonaro (PL-RJ)'s presidential bid.

item.title: O humor de Lula na reunião com os comandantes militares
item.description: President Luiz Inácio Lula da Silva displayed good humor during a meeting with military commanders at the Palácio do Planalto on Thursday (30). The conversation focused on promotions within the Armed Forces. The meeting was described as relaxed, drawing attention from attendees.

item.title: Em evento com Nunes e Tarcísio, Flávio diz que Lula se vinga de SP
item.description: Flávio Bolsonaro accused President Lula of seeking revenge against São Paulo due to the positions of Mayor Ricardo Nunes and Governor Tarcísio de Freitas. He claimed that a new Lula nomination to the Supreme Federal Court would create legal insecurity and hinder major projects and investments in the state. The remarks were made during a breakfast event with Nunes and Tarcísio, attended by city councilors and supporters.

item.title: Caiado usa inquérito contra Lulinha para criticar Lula e Bolsonaro: 'rei protege o príncipe'
item.description: Goiás governor and presidential candidate Ronaldo Caiado (PSD) criticized President Luiz Inácio Lula da Silva (PT) following the opening of an investigation into Lula's son, Fábio Luís Lula da Silva ('Lulinha'), who is suspected of influence peddling in the federal government. Caiado used the phrase 'the king protects the prince' to allege governmental favoritism toward Lula's son, indirectly referencing Jair Bolsonaro in his critique, though Bolsonaro is not explicitly named as the target of the remark.

item.title: Crusoé: Lula não quer renovação alguma na política
item.description: Lula stated he does not seek political renewal and has already prepared many names for succession, citing Brazil’s first female president and Fernando Haddad as examples. He emphasized his strategy is to build leadership within the PT, not name a single successor for 2026. The remarks were made during an interview on the Inteligência Ltda podcast.

item.title: Jaques Wagner diz ter certeza de que vai provar sua inocência na investigação do caso Master
item.description: Senator Jaques Wagner (PT-BA) said he is confident he will prove his innocence in the Master case investigation, which involves suspicions of bribery from Banco Master, and emphasized his focus on the October elections, with a convention scheduled for August 1 featuring Lula. He compared the current situation to the 2018, being investigated for the Fonte Nova Arena case and the process was archived without indictment. Wagner also cited STF Minister André Mendonça, who authorized phone monitoring over suspected data leaks in Operation Compliance Zero, which investigates corruption and money laundering linked to Banco Master and Wagner’s alleged ties to its managers.

item.title: Flávio e PP: a neutralidade fala mais alto que um palanque
item.description: The Progressistas (PP) decided to remain neutral in the 2026 presidential race, which likely prevents Senator Tereza Cristina from joining Flávio Bolsonaro’s ticket. This decision reflects the Centrão’s customary practice of preserving post-election maneuverability, favoring party flexibility over immediate alliances. The PP announced its neutrality on Friday, the 31st, reinforcing its strategy of avoiding premature commitments in presidential contests.

item.title: Jaques Wagner diz que vai provar “inocência” e cita apoio de Lula
item.description: Senator Jaques Wagner (PT-BA) says he is certain he will prove his innocence in the Banco Master investigations, citing Lula’s support and his focus on the October elections. He said he met with the president a few days after the search and seizure operation and confirmed Lula will attend the PT’s convention in Bahia. A PF report, made public by Supreme Court Minister André Mendonça, alleges Wagner received economic benefits from former Banco Master partners and acted in Congress to benefit the bank.
